messages.content: Boundary setting mane nijer limit ta clearly onno keu ke bole deoa, ar sheta maintain kora.
Jemon dhoro ekjon subscriber baar baar free content chai. Tumi bolte paro 'ami appreciate kori tomar interest, kintu free content amar business model na' - eta ekta boundary, clear ar polite duita e.
